label: Orders
caption: CASTRO, SAMANTHA E. F. V. BRITO GUEVARA, JOSE L.
text: The application for stay presented to Justice Alito and by him referred to the Court is denied. The motion of respondent for leave to file a supplemental appendix under seal is granted. The order heretofore entered by Justice Alito is vacated. Justice Sotomayor and Justice Jackson would grant the application.
